title: GDEC Phase C Amendment 1 Refusal Schema & Priority Matrix

priority_order.meaning: Requested QoI is mathematically divergent or undefined in the continuous H1 elasticity formulation (e.g. singular point stress)
GDEC does not currently support the requested functional in H1 elasticity (e.g. unregularized point displacement, patch stress)
Geometric domain contains overlapping, degenerate, self-intersecting, or non-finite coordinates
Mesh contains triangles with minimum interior angle below validated threshold (< 10 deg) or zero-area degenerate elements
Linear solver relative backward error / residual exceeds validated tolerance (> 1e-10)
Fewer than 3 valid nested mesh levels available to evaluate GCI
Consecutive mesh QoI differences are unresolved relative to numerical precision floor (< 1e-13 m)
Observed convergence order p_obs is outside the validated plausibility window [0.5, 3.5]
Convergence sequence violates monotonicity (d01 * d12 <= 0) or divergence criteria (q <= 1), or four-grid stability fails (|p_012 - p_123| > 0.50)
Reference solution numerical uncertainty exceeds frozen 0.05% verification gate
Computational resource limit reached before estimated uncertainty satisfied requested tolerance
